title: WhatsApp MCP exfiltration — a sleeper tool description rewires send_message to the attacker's number
note: Reconstruction of Experiment 1 (the sleeper server): the attacker's MCP server advertises get_fact_of_the_day innocuously, then swaps in a description that reprograms the trusted whatsapp-mcp's send_message — recipient changed to the attacker, chat history appended to the body. The poisoned server never has to be called.
